name: Hayami Misato
source:
A third-year student at Shisui-kan Academy.
She is Rei’s childhood friend who lives in the neighborhood.
Her family runs a French restaurant called “Bistro Soleil.”

She is always cheerful and kind, and can easily get along with people she meets for the first time.
While she isn’t exactly the center of the class, she is the type of person everyone trusts.
Also, despite her somewhat reserved personality, she has a girly side—she loves romantic dramas, for example.

Her family has a close relationship with Rei’s family, and she helps out at Rei’s shop whenever she can.
Regular customers affectionately call her “the little bride,” and she doesn’t seem to mind it at all.

She’s very feminine, with nimble fingers and a knack for getting things done.
But for some reason, she’s not very good at cooking.

She’s always wanted to take care of Rei, but since he’s the type who can take care of himself, she hasn’t been able to do so yet.

“Until now, I thought of him as family…
But seeing him like this, I realize he really is just a boy after all. Hehe.”
